experiments.scope: Inherited reduced lineage fixture for the unchanged P1 family, post-filters and step 3b. Trials 0..7 draw real 38-step chaining values, build the parent reduced table, scan 2^12 words, and independently check every claw, E16 and real-word post-filter flag; trial 8 checks the P8 pair in 3,014 operations. It supplies structural evidence only. Appendix A.15 is the binding bucket7 algorithm and ledger; no parent table price, scan count or score from this fixture is used.

On every working trial: claws_equal_ref = 1, claw_e16_bad = 0, postfilter_ref_mismatch = 0, distinct_pairs = claws. Trial 8: step3b_P8_pair_ok = 1, step3b_P8_pair_ops = 3014. Reproducible observations: occ_frac (about 0.632), claws against expected_claws, the stage counts c1, c1c2, c1c2g, all4, good_pairs (each runs step 3b), step3b_collisions and counted_ops. experiments.scope: Inherited reduced lineage observations for the unchanged H2-P1 q3 transfer and H3-P1 accepted-event structure. Trials 0..7 rebuild both members of every parent-fixture claw and report cumulative rows 16..21 and distinct pairs; trial 8 checks the P8 pair. No pair is returned by design and no rate is inferred. Appendix A.15 is the binding bucket7 algorithm and ledger.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: 0 by design. distinct_pairs = claws and rows_le16 = row16_passes = claws on every working trial (every claw is a row-16 pass of member x and the row-16 tests of both members are functions of E16x); rows_le17 and beyond are 0 at this size because a claw reaches row 17 only as a good pair. Trial 8: step3b_P8_pair_ok = 1. A local emulation took 4.8 s on the same loaded host.

experiments.scope: Structural evidence for the draft seven-entry uniform-reservoir P1 table and the full-scale all-head QREP identity. Trials 0..3 build 2^16 candidates into 2^13 packed 256-bit buckets using the exact capped reservoir build layout, normalize in place to guarded query lanes, and scan 2^12 distinct u words. Because this fixture has 19-bit tags, it computes q and QREP per Wsub through the generic path. Every emitted claw is compared with an independent sorted search, its real E16 and post-filter flags are rebuilt, and step 3b runs on every good pair. Trial 4 checks step 3b on the published P8 pair. Trial 5 exhausts all 127 nonempty handler marker subsets and checks exactly 19 operations per marker. Trial 6 exhausts 35,840 q=507..511 ordinary/adjacent polarity cases. Trial 7 separately exhausts all 512 low-nine-bit P values across all 20 full-scale heads and both offsets, checking the common-q identity and the corrected 538/681, ordinary-12/adjacent-14 inventories. This reduced fixture establishes semantics and the synthetic full-scale identity, not full-scale success rates, H2 or H3.
